articles.title: Chicago Cubs 3B Alex Bregman won’t go on the injured list despite multiple facial fractures
articles.description: Chicago Cubs third baseman Alex Bregman is not ruled out for the regular season, but he still has significant swelling in his face and around his left eye that must improve.

articles.title: After his franchise mark falls, Billy Williams salutes PCA’s evolution during historic Chicago Cubs season
articles.description: It took 56 years, but Pete Crow-Armstrong broke Billy Williams’ Cubs record for home runs by a left-handed hitter. “Ain’t no telling what this kid is going to do in Chicago,” Williams said.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs embrace thrilling off day at Churchill Downs where Alex Bregman’s horse wins race
articles.description: The Chicago Cubs spent Thursday at Churchill Downs in Louisville, Ky., watching horse racing that culminated in Alex Bregman and his family’s horse winning its race.

articles.title: Michael Busch’s baserunning miscue and Chicago Cubs’ lack of execution prove costly in 6-4 loss in Cincinnati
articles.description: For a Chicago Cubs team trying to secure the NL’s top wild-card spot, there were ample moments Friday night that they might dwell on as missed opportunities.

articles.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits historic milestone and Alex Bregman stays hot as Chicago Cubs protect wild-card lead
articles.description: Pete Crow-Armstrong hit a pair of home runs and a triple and Alex Bregman fell a single short of the cycle, leading the Chicago Cubs to an 8-4 win over the Atlanta Braves.

articles.title: ‘That’s my baseball dad’: The Chicago Cubs coach who helped Pete Crow-Armstrong become an MVP-caliber hitter
articles.description: Chicago Cubs assistant hitting coach John Mallee has had a front-row seat to Pete Crow-Armstrong’s evolution over the last four years.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs: Daniel Palencia could again be a postseason game-changer following his best outing since the IL
articles.description: Chicago Cubs reliever Daniel Palencia tossed two perfect innings and struck out three of the six batters he faced in Saturday’s victory. It was an emphatic — and timely — step in the right direction.

articles.title: Chicago Cubs’ Michael Busch is looking to tap into more power and adjust to pitchers’ heavy changeup usage
articles.description: After clobbering changeups in 2024, Chicago Cubs first baseman Michael Busch has struggled against that pitch type, and it’s had a trickle-down effect on his success versus other pitches.

articles.title: Column: Ultimate occupational hazard of managing the Chicago Cubs? The incessant mood swings of fans.
articles.description: It’s easy to manage the Chicago Cubs when they’re winning. When they’re not? Not so much. Craig Counsell has seen both sides this season.
